full.scope: Real C1 input/handoff; earned chapter entries/reload; ride/jump; C4 decoded OGV/audio/visibility; save/layout

fault.scope: Core-only boot; blocked deferred C1; earned C2 picker import; frozen State/save; pointer Retry; whole-family mount; cache reload zero C2 HTTP

missingHost.scope: Missing host in first Document only; fatal overlay/no automatic reload; real pointer reload restores ordinary alarm

webkit.scope: v4 online C1/C2 input/import/reload; blocked-cache recovery unproven

firefoxHistorical.scope: Historical v3 case only; whole mixed-engine report failed

visual.receiptRule: Each current Chromium report directory contains screenshot-cleanup.json with image bytes/SHA256.

limits: Local automation; no full manual campaign, physical-device, old-browser, remote-speed or human-audibility acceptance.
Failed/pre-final attempts are retained and excluded; v3 is historical. Build used a dirty source tree; input hash binds tested bytes.
